integrity: An analytic proof and a standalone finite checker are supplied. Numerical checks do not prove infinite-time statements. Independent scientific validation has not been performed.
limitations: Exactly neutral slope -1, harmonic forcing 1+cos(theta), irrational base rotation and forcing 0<b<=b*. Results are uniform minimax laws, not pointwise lower rates for each trajectory. Historical priority remains provisional.
title: Sharp arithmetic collapse of neutral two-cycles at a quasiperiodic flip boundary
